timeline.summary: Urza settles on Shiv by making peace with Gherridarigaaz and persuading goblins to work with viashino; the Rig produces powerstones for his Legacy.
timeline.quote: managed to settle with the viashino living by the Rig by making peace with the dragon Gherridarigaaz

citation.text: "Shiv", section "Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Icatian army repels early Orc surprise attacks on border towns like Montford.
timeline.quote: The Icatian army easily repelled early surprise attacks by the Orcs on border towns like Montford.

citation.text: Icatian Infantry (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Goblin and Orcish armies crush the sparsely defended Dwarven cities with War Drums.
timeline.quote: The War Drums enabled Goblin and Orcish armies to crush the sparsely defended Dwarven cities.

citation.text: Goblin War Drums (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Dwarves' civilization is the first to fall, its name lost.
timeline.quote: their civilization was the first to fall, and its name was sadly lost

citation.text: Dwarven Soldier (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Unsuccessful in their early battle for Montford, the Orcs temper their bloodlust with cowardice.
timeline.quote: Unsuccessful in their early battle for Montford, the Orcs quickly tempered their bloodlust with cowardice.

citation.text: Orcish Veteran (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Corporal Peter Douglas's line breaks to the War Drums in the dark.
timeline.quote: Dobbs, on my right, broke first.

citation.text: Goblin War Drums (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarpadian goblins and orcs destroy the dwarven nations.
timeline.quote: They and the Sarpadian orcs destroyed the dwarven nations of the continent.

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dwarven kingdom falls to a chaos-driven army of orcs and goblins, followed by the Ebon Hand falling to the thrulls and the elves to the thallids.
timeline.quote: starting with the fall of the dwarven kingdom to a chaos-driven army of orcs and goblins

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Fall of the Empires". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Icatia, weakened by the Farrelite Cult, finally falls to orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids aided by Tevesh Szat, and Vodalia is conquered by homarids.
timeline.quote: The last empire to fall was Icatia

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Fall of the Empires". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The thrulls destroy the goblins and the last of the orcs and keep evolving, content with their isolation.
timeline.quote: the goblins were destroyed by the thrulls

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Thrull Rebellion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orcs invented a destructive weapon, and critics became its artillerists.
timeline.quote: Most Orcish artillerists are those who dared criticize its effectiveness.

citation.text: Orcish Artillery (Rivals Quick Start Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aerona goblins join their one-time human enemies against the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: joined forces with their one-time human enemies during the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria and were trained as soldiers

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Aerona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ghitu and goblins fight over the Rig; Jhoira negotiates a truce and repairs it.
timeline.quote: Jhoira negotiated a truce and managed to repair the Mana Rig

citation.text: "Shiv", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Goblins laugh as an elf runs away, until more elves return.
timeline.quote: The goblins laughed as the elf ran away, until more came back.

citation.text: Wirewood Herald (Duel Decks: Elves vs. Goblins, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
